messages:
maya: Hey team — planning a condensed RFC clinic next Tue 10:30-11:30 (US PT). Goal: run 4 short RFCs (10m talk + 5m q&a) and finish with any triage decisions. Can folks claim author slots and confirm reviewer availability?

oliver: I can review. prefer first or second slot.

sam: @maya I can present something — small infra tweak RFC (will be ~6 slides). Claiming slot 3 if that works.

maya: @sam slot 3 noted. @oliver I'll tentatively put you as primary reviewer for slot 1.

tanya: I can do reviewer for slot 2 or 4. If you need a backup reviewer for infra, I can take it.

aj: +1 for slot 4 reviewer. Also can present a short follow-up on rollout policy if an open slot remains.

maya: Great — current plan: slot order draft:
1) author: leo (10m) — reviewer: oliver
2) author: aj? (10m) — reviewer: tanya
3) author: sam (infra tweak) — reviewer: oliver (backup: tanya)
4) author: aj (rollout follow-up) or open lightning

leo: I can do slot 1. Will post pre-read by EOD Mon.

aj: I can take slot 2 or 4. Prefer 4 if folks want a deeper discussion earlier.

maya: Ok @aj, move you to slot 4 then. Slot 2 is open — anyone else?

oliver: I have a calendar conflict 10:40-10:55, so if possible put my review slot at the start or after 10:55.

maya: Good catch. Let's shift:
- slot 1: leo (10:30-10:45) reviewer oliver
- slot 2: open (10:45-10:55) — short lightning, volunteer?
- slot 3: sam (10:55-11:05) reviewer tanya (oliver backup)
- slot 4: aj (11:05-11:20) reviewer aj? or tanya

sam: Works for me. I'll make sure pre-read has a 1-pager + TL;DR.

tanya: I can review slot 3 and 4.

maya: Reminder items for authors:
- upload RFC/slide deck to the rfc-reviews folder by Mon 6pm PT
- add a 2–3 sentence "ask" at the top (decision we want)
- mark any blockers/issues that need follow-up

maya: Agenda template (paste into doc):
```
- 2m intro / goals
- 10m author presentation
- 5m questions + quick decision or action items
- 3m buffer for overruns
```

leo: Will add slides + link to PR.

aj: I'll post mine as a short note — might not need slides.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "RFC clinic — Tue 10:30" • Guests: eng • Zoom link added • Reminder: Mon 6pm pre-read cutoff

maya: If no one volunteers for slot 2 by EOD Fri, we'll convert it to an open triage block (quickbacks and blocked items).

sam: Quick Q — should authors include perf numbers in pre-read?

maya: Yes if available. If not, include expected perf impact and follow-up measurement plan.

oliver: I put myself as reviewer for slot 1 but if my conflict overlaps I'll ping to swap with tanya.

tanya: Ready to swap if needed.

maya: Thanks everyone — I'll update the calendar and the rfc-reviews doc with slots + links. Ping me if you need more than 10m. :rocket:
